body:
**Starts** once #57 is merged.

## Why

The map shows the route and the trip's places at a glance, beside the itinerary view (functional spec 9.2).

## Design

- [Functional spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/functional-spec.md), section 9.2.
- [Google design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/data-sources/google.md), section 4.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Add the Google map to the itinerary view, with the Google Maps browser key (Google design, section 4). It shows the route lines, and different markers for stays, attractions, and restaurants. Clicking a marker shows the item's details.
- The `web` build already gets the browser key: the workflow passes the GitHub repo variable `VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_KEY` to it (systems design section 7).

## Done when

- On the deployed site (systems design, section 7), the San Francisco trip's map, from domain model section 5.1, shows the route down the coast, and its markers.
- The map works on `localhost` too.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

---

Moved from the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md#phase-25-the-map).
